rationale: The plan matches the reference on every point: DESeq2 Wald on raw counts for a 6-vs-6 unpaired single-batch design, blind-VST PCA and distance heatmap with sample_01 labeled and its library-size fold-difference reported, retention by default with removal only on a stated PCA/distance finding plus a sensitivity fit. The filter (>=10 counts in >=6 samples, the smallest group) is minimal and justified, normalization is median-of-ratios inside the model with no pre-scaling, the design ~condition has chow explicitly set as reference and the contrast is named, and apeglm shrinkage with BH at alpha 0.05 is applied inside the test. Enrichment uses the native mouse Hallmark MH collection (versioned), fgsea preranked on the full tested list ranked by Wald statistic with a 15-500 size window, seed, and universe stated, correctly avoiding an unmapped human-set approach. The report step names versions, design, thresholds, tested/significant counts, sessionInfo, and an explicit sample_01 handling paragraph.
